parameters.content:
## 💊 Pharmacy Expiry Cascade

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning to read pharmacy inventory, sales, branch stock, and supplier policy data from Google Sheets, then calculates which batches are approaching expiry. It packages recommended actions, uses Gemini to create a pharmacist-facing briefing, and sends it to Slack for approval. Approved actions are logged, routed, and executed through sheet updates, branch or supplier emails, and compliance alerts.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials and set the correct sheet_id in the Config node, ensuring the inventory, sales log, branch stock, supplier policies, decision log, reorder, and batch status sheets/tabs have the expected columns.
- Configure Slack credentials, the slack_channel_id, and any Slack interactivity/approval settings needed for the Pharmacist Approval and Compliance Alert nodes.
- Configure Google Gemini credentials for the Gemini Chat Model used by the Pharmacist Briefing chain.
- Configure Gmail credentials for the branch and supplier email nodes, and set email_override if test routing or a fixed recipient is required.
- Review the Daily 6AM schedule timezone and set horizon_days to the desired expiry look-ahead window.

### Customization

Adjust horizon_days, supplier policy fields, approval text, routing rules, and the email/Slack message templates to match the pharmacy’s operating procedures and escalation thresholds.

@[youtube](_kkyXHRt51c)

## Schedule and configuration

Starts the daily expiry run and sets workflow-wide parameters such as sheet ID, Slack channel, email override, and expiry horizon.

## Read pharmacy data

Loads the source datasets from Google Sheets, including inventory, sales history, branch stock levels, and supplier policy rules.

## Calculate expiry actions

Runs the main expiry logic and aggregates the resulting recommendations into a package for downstream review.

## Generate pharmacist briefing

Uses an LLM chain with the Gemini chat model to turn the calculated actions into a clear pharmacist briefing.

## Capture approval decision

Sends the briefing for Slack approval, extracts the decision metadata, splits the approved action list, and flattens each action into usable fields.

## Audit and gate actions

Records each decision to Google Sheets and checks whether the action was approved before allowing execution branches to proceed.

## Update operational sheets

Applies approved inventory-side updates by marking affected batches and updating reorder controls in Google Sheets.

## Route notifications

Routes approved actions by type and sends the appropriate external notifications to branches, suppliers, or compliance staff.

nodes.name: Set Configuration Parameters
nodes.notes: email_override: while testing, ALL emails go to this address. Clear it (empty) to email real branches and suppliers.

nodes.name: Calculate Expiry Decisions
nodes.notes: The only Code node: velocity, FEFO projection, safety flags, transfer/return options, decision ladder.

nodes.name: Prepare Pharmacist Briefing
nodes.notes: AI writes the morning note only. Quantities and actions come from the rules.

parameters.text:
=You are a pharmacy operations assistant writing the morning note for a licensed pharmacist.
The rules engine has already decided every action. Do not change or invent any number.
Write exactly 3 short lines of plain text:
1) the headline: how many batches are at risk and the total value at risk in rupees.
2) the patient-safety line: call out anything life-saving, chronic, cold-chain, controlled or already expired, in plain words (e.g. insulin is life-saving: we keep minimum stock so no patient goes without).
3) what you need from them: review and approve or reject below.
Never encourage selling prescription medicines. Calm and human, not alarmist. No markdown.

FACTS (use these exact numbers, do not recalculate): batches_at_risk = {{ $json.actions.length }}, total_value_at_risk_rupees = {{ $json.actions.reduce((s, a) => s + a.value_at_risk, 0) }}.

DATA:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.actions.map(a => ({ drug: a.drug_name, branch: a.branch_name, days_left: a.days_left, expiring_units: a.expiry_units, value_at_risk: a.value_at_risk, flags: a.flags, plan: a.plan_text }))) }}

nodes.name: Append Decision to Sheets
nodes.notes: Audit trail: every decision, approved or rejected.

nodes.name: Route Actions by Approval
nodes.notes: A row can match several outputs. Controlled drugs never get auto-emailed.

nodes.notes: Your purchasing sheet / POS reads this tab. STOP = do not reorder. MIN_STOCK = never let stock fall below min_stock_units.

nodes.name: Update Batch Information
